name: agensis
summary: Agensis is a realtime collaborative workspace for chat, documents, memory, tasks, files, AI agents, and a shared canvas. The root app shows sign-in until authenticated, then opens the workspace shell.

appearance.greeting: Need help finding your way around agensis?

important: Sign in or create an account to reach the workspace.
The left sidebar opens channels, threads, documents, direct agent messages, tasks, memory, activity, agents, users, and applets.
The center workspace is a shared realtime canvas with floating windows and a bottom dock.
The home composer starts workspace-level chat and can link documents with @.
AI Agents is where agents are created, edited, connected to daemon clients, and given webhooks.
Production agent daemon WebSockets require a separate long-running backend configured with AGENSIS_DAEMON_BASE_URL.
avoid: Do not ask users for API keys, database URLs, auth secrets, or other credentials.
Do not assume live daemon agents are available on static or serverless-only hosts.
Do not invent builder or live-agent path routes; this app exposes the workspace shell and a /#showcase gallery.

actions.label: Explain agents
actions.task: Explain how to open Agents from the sidebar, create or edit an agent, and copy a connection command. Mention that live daemon connections depend on backend configuration.

actions.label: Explain the canvas
actions.task: Explain the shared canvas, floating windows, the bottom dock, realtime presence, and the workspace composer in a short practical overview.

tour.say: If you are signed out, this page is the auth gate. After sign-in, the same root route becomes the workspace canvas.
The sidebar is the primary navigation for workspaces, channels, documents, direct agent messages, tasks, memory, agents, users, and applets.
Use the workspace composer for broad chat. Type @ to link a document when the document picker is available.
This is the shared workspace viewport. Canvas objects, floating windows, realtime presence, and drawing tools live here.
Open windows are managed from the bottom dock, including chat, documents, memory, tasks, activity, and agents.
Presence and notifications sit in the lower-right workspace controls.
When the Agents window is open, this area lists agents, status filters, creation tools, connection commands, and webhook controls.

/.summary: The root app route. Signed-out users see authentication; signed-in users see the realtime workspace shell.
important: There are no separate builder or live-agent pathname routes in this app.
The component gallery is reached by the /#showcase hash, not by a pathname route.

actions.label: Where do agents live?
actions.task: Tell the user to open Agents from the sidebar, then explain Create Agent, Connect a client, connection commands, and daemon backend requirements.
